objective: Validate and measure the AVX2 single-token recurrent Gated DeltaNet state update at the exact Qwen3.8-27B shape, including an actual 48-layer state stream that cannot fit in a small private cache

scope.operator: single-token recurrent Gated DeltaNet state update
scope.claim_boundary: isolated recurrence only; excludes projections, causal convolution, normalization, attention, MLP, lexical operators, sampling, and end-to-end model execution

candidate.numeric_contract: separate FP32 multiply and add in the same per-column row order as the scalar oracle; no FMA contraction
candidate.state_update: in place without materialized repeated q/k heads or per-token state allocation
candidate.trusted_entry_contract: the enclosing graph guarantees finite q/k/value/decay/beta/state; the entry point still checks pointers and dimensions and the kernel still rejects non-finite output

control.equations: decay state; memory = key @ state; delta = (value - memory) * beta; state += outer(key, delta); output = query @ state
control.parity_requirement: bit-exact FP32 output and final state at the exact one-layer model shape

measurement.one_layer_order: alternating scalar-avx2 and avx2-scalar pairs with state reset outside the timed interval
measurement.full_stack_state: 48 independent 3 MiB recurrent states, updated sequentially without reset between timed tokens
measurement.cache_interpretation: the full 144 MiB state stream is authoritative for recurrence-only tokens/s; one-layer latency is a kernel diagnostic only

promotion_rules: a pass promotes only the AVX2 recurrence implementation from reference to measured kernel
a pass does not establish full-layer parity because projections, convolution, normalization, gating, and output projection remain outside this benchmark
a pass does not establish end-to-end tokens per second, model capability, storage efficiency, or energy efficiency
CUTE plus MMLU-type or MATH-500 capability gates remain mandatory after graph integration
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
no scientific breakthrough claim can come from this isolated microkernel
